capability: contracts.accountSelfService: 1, plus top-level emailChange: confirm | immediate
description: Account basics for the person who owns the account: a summary, a full export, delete, and change email. A client that does not see the capability hides these actions.

summary.response: {email, twoFactorEnabled, counts: {people, medications, routines, doses, inventoryEvents, devices, settings}}

export.never: password hashes, API key hashes, encrypted keys, TOTP secrets, backup codes, tokens, IP addresses

delete.request: {password, code?} code is the 6-digit or backup code when 2FA is on
delete.afterwards: every device sends a key that is no longer known; the server answers 401 ACCOUNT_DELETED for api-key and live refresh-token hashes it remembers for markerDays, so the app wipes its local data instead of asking to re-pair

changeEmail.confirm: POST /api/v1/auth/change-email/confirm {token} without authentication; the token lives 24 hours and one request replaces the previous one
